In its original Arabic roots, 'an' is a term often used in the context of God's Grace, and 'az' alludes to the sweet fragrance of the flowers that remind us of His decaying beauty. It is a name that calls us to remember the divine wonders of the world and to appreciate the sweetness of life that is a gift from Allah.
